meta.name: Agent assist for synthetic support calls (Google Cloud)

data.label: Synthetic call / telephony source
data.description: An existing or synthetic call audio source outside provisioning scope. It receives calls only; the system never places calls.

data.label: Consent gate
data.description: Records the caller's consent with a timestamp. If consent is missing, the audio stops here.
data.service: Cloud Run (consent service) + Firestore consent record

data.label: Audio ingestion
data.description: Receives consented audio over gRPC/WebSocket and streams it to Speech-to-Text. Raw audio is not kept unless a retention rule is agreed.

data.label: Transcription
data.description: Streaming transcription in near real time. Language and model choice depend on the region; availability is unverified.

data.label: PII redaction
data.description: Removes personal details from transcript segments before any model, storage or log sees them.

data.label: Support knowledge base
data.description: Approved support articles used to ground suggestions. The source content is still to be confirmed.

data.label: Agent-assist orchestrator
data.description: Takes the redacted transcript, retrieves passages and asks Gemini for cited suggestions, a summary and a CRM draft. It has no tool for placing calls or writing to the CRM.

data.label: Gemini model
data.description: Generates suggestions and summaries. Model version, quotas and regional access are unverified; local tests use scripted replies.

data.label: Support agent desktop
data.description: The support agent (a person) sees suggestions and edits/approves the summary and the CRM draft.

data.label: Approved summaries & CRM drafts
data.description: Stores redacted summaries and CRM drafts with their approval status and who approved them.

data.label: Existing CRM
data.description: The existing CRM, outside provisioning scope. The system has no write access; the agent applies an approved draft by hand.

data.label: Audit & monitoring
data.description: Logs consent decisions, redaction results, approvals and errors, without raw personal data.

edges.label: cited suggestions, draft summary & CRM draft

brief.application: Use Google Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Assist an agent during a synthetic support call. Include consent, audio ingestion, transcription, PII redaction, grounded agent suggestions, an approved call summary and a draft update to an existing CRM. Do not place calls or write CRM records automatically. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

lastAsked.question: Which tools should it be allowed to use?
lastAsked.beginner: For example “read and update tickets, send emails, look up orders”.
lastAsked.why: It shapes the An agent with tools design.

requirements.statement: Proposed: no call audio is transcribed or processed until consent is recorded; without consent, nothing is processed.
requirements.rationale: Prevents processing call audio without consent, which is a legal and trust risk.

requirements.statement: Proposed: personal details are removed from transcripts before any model call, storage or log.
requirements.rationale: Limits exposure of personal data to the model and logs.

requirements.statement: Proposed: summaries and CRM updates are drafts until the agent approves them; the system can't place calls or write CRM records.
requirements.rationale: Prevents unreviewed AI output from changing customer records.
requirements.basis: User: "Do not place calls or write CRM records automatically."

decisions.subject: design.google-cloud-agent-assist-sketch-for-synthetic-support-calls
decisions.title: Google Cloud agent-assist sketch for synthetic support calls
decisions.context: Scope: consent, audio ingestion, streaming transcription, PII redaction, grounded suggestions, an approved summary and a draft CRM update, all for synthetic calls. Assumptions: no outbound calls and no automated CRM writes; the agent approves summaries and drafts and applies CRM changes by hand. The region, project and model access are not verified. Nothing has a typed generator yet, so implementation is engineering work.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.
